offering_description.value: Operates Adelphic, a cloud-based demand-side platform that lets advertisers and agencies plan, buy and measure digital ad campaigns across connected TV, mobile, display, audio and other channels. It sells mainly to advertising agencies and brands, with a focus on connected TV and household-level targeting.

primary_products.value: demand-side advertising software platform; connected TV ad buying tools; advertising analytics and measurement tools

primary_services.value: managed campaign services; digital ad buying and optimization; advertising measurement and analytics

customer_segment.value: B2B: advertising agencies, brands and advertisers buying digital media

end_markets.value: digital advertising; connected TV; marketing and media; consumer brands; automotive and retail advertisers

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: percentage-of-spend platform fees on ad media purchased through the platform; service fees: managed services for campaign execution and optimization
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; service fees

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: runs a demand-side platform that buys ad inventory from publishers and exchanges, sold to agencies and advertisers

geography_served.value: global: Mainly United States, with offices and customers in Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: related lines: demand-side platform, connected TV buying, and measurement and data tools for advertisers

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to agencies and advertisers; online: self-service platform access for ad buyers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and advertising rules such as CCPA, GDPR and FTC oversight of consumer data use
